body.x: Sony(www.sony.com) announced FDR AX100 at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is being held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

This new camcorder gives consumers both a comparably low price and high-quality 4K footage. The new 4K Handycam FDR-AX100 is a relatively compact camcorder capable of shooting 4K video at both 24 and 30P easily and it has a wide-angle lens — 29mm — with a large optical zoom range of up to 12x. In addition, it has built-in NFC and Wi-Fi, allowing it to stream video to a TV or be controlled from a smartphone.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
